title: Cosmic Fleur-de-Lis Serpent
description: A surreal cosmic scene centered on a glowing yellow and green Fleur-de-Lis emblem surrounded by a swirling nebula of purple, red, and blue. A black snake coils around the emblem while another rests below; to the left is a glass orb containing colorful pebbles, to the upper right a cracked bleeding heart, and to the lower right a detailed corn stalk, all set upon a bed of smooth river stones.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork featuring a large glowing yellow and green Fleur-de-lis at the center of a swirling cosmic nebula in purples, reds and blues. A black serpent coils around the emblem with its tongue out. In the foreground are smooth river stones. To the left, a transparent glass orb filled with colorful pebbles. Upper right shows a white broken heart with red cracks and dripping blood. Lower right contains a detailed monochrome corn stalk. Mystical and symbolic atmosphere.
